column3: NKJV has the clauses in the order of the Textus Receptus, ending with “Or if we are comforted … salvation”; the critical text places the comfort clause before “which is effective.”
NKJV has “and does deliver us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “and will deliver us.”
NKJV has “in simplicity,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in holiness.”
NKJV has “and in Him Amen,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “therefore also through Him the Amen.”
